strings.en: Ariel Org, carrying out the mission.
With this timing, I can strike first...!
With Flickerei, I can do this.
It should handle just like Flickerei.
That unit is the commander unit...!
Jua-Mu, I won't let you have your way.
Jua-Mu... We can't back down either.
Al-Van Ranks... I can't let my guard down.
A black Raftclans... I must attack cautiously!
I won't let you have Princess Shana-Mia/　or the Throne Unit!
Balmar's vanguard... I must collect data.
Why are they after Lieutenant Ing...?!
If the Pilot is human, there will be doubt...
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　What is his true aim in showing himself...?
Gadisword's ace... I can't let my guard down.
I'll break through you and reach the Rabulpaila...!
Herluga, your research will bring ruin!
You'll pay the price for toying with the Cross Gate...!
It seems it can control any unit...!
I must watch the wings and tail too...
The Skull Knight's mobility can't be underestimated...!
It doesn't seem to run on/　its skeleton alone...!
I cannot accept/　your twisted logic!
XN-L... A world teeming with life/　has no need for a being like you!
However thick the barrage, there must be a gap...!
New model recognized as high-alert target...!
I must annihilate them before they multiply.
I must stop the giant Lamaris...!
The reason Ares Geist appeared here...!
I know this is/　a long-shot bet...!
To move Ares Geist/　out of there...!
System down... This is the end...
I leave the rest to you...
At this rate,/　the Servomotors will burn out...!
As long as the ACS works, I can fight...!
Main frame damaged.../　At this rate...!
Still recoverable... I won't give up!
As long as the Fau Kern is intact,/　I can keep fighting...!
Fricklei... I'll make it hold out!
If not for the Alt, that would've been close...!
An attack like that, inside their own ship...!
There's no way the machine can hold out/　if it keeps using that power...!
We have to destroy the deity ship first...!
I have to stop the Crystal Dragoon/　right here...!
Updating Skull Knight data...!/　I'll dodge it next time!
Ngh! I can't stop/　the Lamaris Ida...?!
Ares... No matter what, it must be by my hand...!
I can't win a contest of power... So then!
Ngh! I can't stop the Ares!?
The damage has reached/　the secondary armor...!
If the frame connectors are intact...!
Motor No. 4 is spinning idle.../　Pausing it, recovering!
I have to regain my footing...!
Fricklei,/　we cannot afford to lose.
Even the Alt has to avoid direct hits...
Its durability rivals a super robot's...
To think I can't shake off Jua-Mu...!
I must read Al-Van's movements precisely...!
I need to keep the right distance from Fu-Ruu...!
If I waste time on Reggiane,/　the Cross Gate will...!
Even the Cross Gate's power/　can't be all-powerful...!
XN-L! I won't let you go any further!
I can't be defeated by Ares here!
I must be the one to stop the Ares Geist...!
I'll keep drawing the Ares Geist's attention...!
Attack patterns updated. I'll evade next time.
That won't be enough to stop Flickerei.
As expected of Alt... It's sturdy.
That won't be enough to stop Alt.
Its abilities match or exceed a knight's...!
It seems your analysis of our forces/　is lacking, Gomoudokka.
I can't let them keep buying time...!
Such agile movements for its size...!
The Skull Knight is faster than predicted...!
I must hurry and analyze XN-L's attack patterns...!
It seems the Zovorg units are updating their data too.
You seem to have studied us well.
Minor damage. I'll keep drawing them in.
The Lamaris are getting more active...!
Updating the Lamaris Kaana's attack patterns.
I don't intend to be a target.
So-Des, I've already read your moves.
Its pattern differs from the other Raftclans...
Iradoya... your tactics won't work on me.
Did that pilot miss on purpose...?
Reggiane, I won't fall prey to you.
Whatever energy you use, it's no good if it can't hit!
You seem to have certain habits, Debudedabide.
It doesn't seem to have the OryuOh's power.
The Skull Knight's movements won't confuse me.
You have no right to decide our fate.
Predicting that unit's actions is easy.
I've already grasped your attack patterns.
You won't have your way with Earth.
Just as predicted, you came at me.
I can't spend time on the Lamaris.
I can't be held up by a Kaana type!
I have to draw it away from there quickly!
I'll dodge the next one too.
Those movements can't lock onto me.
Is that the end of your attack?
Every attack has a point/　where it can be read.
Its burst speed comes from Alteisen.
Heavier than Flickerei, but/　no problem.
I have a grasp of the Gespenst Haken's habits.
Can't counter... I need to open distance.
If I don't move, I'll be a target...
I must read the enemy precisely...
Arieil Org,/　moving to back you up.
Lieutenant Excellen, I'll take it from here.
Lieutenant Kusuha, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Lamia's moves are easy to match.
Seolla, I'll take it from here.
Arado, the situation isn't over yet.
Latune, I'll take it from here.
Josh, I'll take it from here.
Ing, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Rio, leave the rest to me.
Touya, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Yon, leave the rest to me.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Lieutenant Lamia, leave this to me!
The Flickerei will take the hit!
Even for an Alt, it's too dangerous!
I'll destroy them all at once.
Understood, Lieutenant Kyosuke./　I'll provide support.
We're both Alts, so to speak./　Easy to sync up.
It didn't go as smoothly/　as it does for Lieutenant Excellen...
I cannot afford to/　waste these Missiles.
Warning to all units!/　Using the MAPW!
This will take them all out at once!
This weapon is not just for show!
I'll drive you into a corner!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
So stiff! You gotta show more personality!
This calls for the Sword Launcher!
I'll corner you with consecutive strikes!
I'll stop you in your tracks!
